title: Rounding of provident fund contributions
description: How each provident fund, pension and insurance contribution is rounded, in its scheme's words: to the nearest rupee, a fraction of a rupee from the amount held counting as the next higher rupee and a smaller fraction being ignored. Until 28 June 2026 the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952, the Employees' Pension Scheme, 1995 and the Employees' Deposit-Linked Insurance Scheme, 1976, continued by section 164(2) of the Code on Social Security, 2020, set the rule, and from 29 June 2026 the Schemes of 2026. The rounding of the administrative charges was not read in an instrument.

cells.name: Provident Fund contributions
cells.wording: Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952, paragraph 29: Each contribution shall be calculated to the nearest rupee, 50 paise or more to be counted as the next higher rupee …
